meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 ast-grep（sg）按代码的语法结构而不是文本去搜索和改写，覆盖 25 种语言：找出形如某个模式的函数、调用、类、导入，执行批量改写（codemod），或运行 YAML 规则扫描。
howto.when: 当目标是语法结构（某个形状的调用、类、导入，codemod，YAML 规则）而不是字面文本时触发；纯字符串、注释或文件名则改用 rg。

say.text: 找出仓库里所有的空 catch 块
say.note: 按语法结构匹配，不是文本搜索

say.text: 把仓库里的 require() 都改成 import
say.note: 会汇报受影响文件数量

howto.what_en: Claude uses ast-grep (sg) to search and rewrite code by syntax structure rather than text, across 25 languages: find functions, calls, classes or imports shaped like X, run deterministic codemods, or scan YAML rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is a syntax shape (a call/class/import pattern, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments or filenames it uses rg instead.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x), show me the preview first
say_en.note: Dry-run is the default; no files change

say_en.text: Find all the empty catch blocks in this repo
say_en.note: Matches by syntax structure, not text

say_en.text: Replace require() with import across the repo
say_en.note: Reports how many files are affected
